entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit customer support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please have your order number ready.
Hello, you've reached VeloFit. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Hi Diana. I'm calling about an order I placed about a month ago. I need to return an item.
I can certainly look into that for you. Do you have the order number handy?

Thank you. One moment... Okay, I see the order for the VeloBand Pulse HR Monitor, delivered on December 21st. That was about 35 days ago. What specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
It's more of a preference. It works fine, but the fit isn't quite right for my wrist during long runs. It's just not comfortable for me.

I understand completely. Getting the right fit is crucial. Let me just check the return eligibility for you... Okay, I'm looking at our policy now, and it says items can be returned within 90 days of delivery. So you are well within the window. We can definitely get that return started for you.

Oh, that's great. To be honest, I was a little worried. I actually tried to process the return online much earlier, on the 9th day after I got it, but there was a major website error. The whole return system was down and I couldn't print the label.

I'm so sorry you experienced that. Let me check our system logs for that timeframe... Yes, I see a note about a service outage on that date. It says the portal was down for several hours. Did you happen to grab a screenshot of the error message by any chance?
I did, actually. I always take a screenshot when something like that happens. I can email it to you if you need it for the exception.

Thank you for being so thorough, but it won't be necessary. You're well within the 90-day period anyway, so we can approve this without any issue. But I do appreciate you letting me know, and I'll add a note to your file about the trouble you had. I'll email you the return label right now.

I appreciate that, Diana. Now, since I did have that trouble with the website and it delayed me, I'm wondering if we could work something out. I'm still planning to buy a different VeloFit product. Is there perhaps a discount code you could offer for my next purchase to compensate for the inconvenience?

That's a very reasonable request, especially given the confirmed system down issue and your loyalty as a VIP customer. For the trouble you went through, I can certainly offer you a 20% discount code for your next VeloFit purchase. How does that sound?
That sounds perfect. A full refund on the band and a 20% discount is more than fair. Thank you for your help.
You're very welcome. I've just sent two emails. One has your pre-paid return label, and the second contains your unique 20% discount code. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. You've been very helpful, Diana.
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day!
